title: Two-Variable Workshop Profit Maximization LP
description: Textbook two-variable CPLEX LP maximizing workshop profit subject to CNC milling, finishing, and raw-material availability constraints.
code:
\ Two-Variable Workshop Profit Maximization LP
Maximize
  profit: 45 x1 + 60 x2
Subject To
  milling:   2 x1 + 3 x2 <= 120
  finishing: 1 x1 + 2 x2 <= 70
  material:  3 x1 + 1 x2 <= 135
Bounds
  0 <= x1 <= 45
  0 <= x2 <= 35
End

title: Diet Optimization with Bounded Nutrients
description: Minimum-cost clinical diet formulation with lower and upper bounds on daily servings, calories, protein, and sodium intake.
code:
\ Minimum-Cost Clinical Diet Optimization with Bounded Servings
Minimize
  cost: 0.40 oats + 2.20 salmon + 0.60 milk + 0.50 lentils
Subject To
  calories_min: 300 oats + 250 salmon + 150 milk + 230 lentils >= 1900
  protein_min:   10 oats +  28 salmon +   8 milk +  18 lentils >= 75
  calcium_min:   40 oats +  20 salmon + 300 milk +  40 lentils >= 700
  sodium_max:     5 oats + 120 salmon + 100 milk +  10 lentils <= 1200
Bounds
  1 <= oats <= 4
  0 <= salmon <= 3
  1 <= milk <= 5
  0 <= lentils <= 4
End

title: Factory Shift Scheduling Integer Program
description: Pure integer program (Generals) determining minimum operator headcount across overlapping 8-hour shifts to cover 24-hour plant staffing requirements.
code:
\ 24-Hour Factory Shift Scheduling Integer Program
Minimize
  headcount: 180 s1 + 195 s2 + 210 s3 + 225 s4
Subject To
  block_00_06: s4 + s1 >= 8
  block_06_12: s1 + s2 >= 14
  block_12_18: s2 + s3 >= 16
  block_18_24: s3 + s4 >= 10
Bounds
  0 <= s1 <= 20
  0 <= s2 <= 20
  0 <= s3 <= 20
  0 <= s4 <= 20
Generals
  s1 s2 s3 s4
End

title: Markowitz Portfolio Variance Quadratic Program
description: Convex quadratic program (QP) minimizing portfolio return variance across three asset classes subject to full capital allocation and minimum expected return.
code:
\ Markowitz Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization QP
Minimize
  variance: - 0.01 w1 - 0.02 w2 - 0.005 w3
            + [ 0.08 w1 ^ 2 + 0.04 w1 * w2 + 0.14 w2 ^ 2 + 0.02 w2 * w3 + 0.03 w3 ^ 2 ] / 2
Subject To
  budget:     w1 + w2 + w3 = 1
  min_return: 0.08 w1 + 0.12 w2 + 0.04 w3 >= 0.08
Bounds
  0 <= w1 <= 0.7
  0 <= w2 <= 0.7
  0 <= w3 <= 0.7
End

title: Multi-Commodity Supply Chain Network MILP
description: Mixed-integer supply chain design combining binary plant openings, integer truck dispatches, and continuous commodity flows to meet regional demand at minimum cost.
code:
\ Multi-Commodity Supply Chain Design MILP
Minimize
  total_cost: 500 y1 + 620 y2 + 45 t1 + 50 t2
              + 4 x11 + 7 x12 + 6 x21 + 3 x22
Subject To
  demand_r1:   x11 + x21 = 60
  demand_r2:   x12 + x22 = 80
  cap_plant1:  x11 + x12 - 110 y1 <= 0
  cap_plant2:  x21 + x22 - 130 y2 <= 0
  trucks_p1:   x11 + x12 - 25 t1 <= 0
  trucks_p2:   x21 + x22 - 25 t2 <= 0
Bounds
  0 <= x11 <= 110
  0 <= x12 <= 110
  0 <= x21 <= 130
  0 <= x22 <= 130
  0 <= t1 <= 10
  0 <= t2 <= 10
Generals
  t1 t2
Binaries
  y1 y2
End
